questions.q: Which is a staff-level difference from a senior answer?
options: Questions the premise and offers options with a recommendation
why: Depth is expected in key areas.

questions.q: Scenario: you have 45 minutes. How do you use the middle part?
options: Two or three in-depth sections on the riskiest parts, with numbers

questions.q: One GPU scores 400 series per second. How many minutes for 480,000 series on one GPU?
What is the purpose of shadow mode in a migration?
options: Compare the new system with the old one on live data without using its output

questions.q: Put the migration steps in a sensible order.
options: Reach parity on the golden backtest
Canary and staged ramp with rollback
questions.why: Know the users, prove parity, compare live, ramp carefully, then remove the old path.
